# Layout brief — chunk 1a: `bias_gen`

**Status: ready to draw (2026-11-08), sizes final after the Phase 2 sweep.** Schematic: `xschem/bias_gen.sch` (generated by `xschem/gen_bias_gen.py`).
Netlist for LVS: `sim/out/netlist/bias_gen.spice` (`tools/netlist.sh bias_gen`).
Phase 1 + Phase 2 results: `sim/bias/results.md`, `sim/bias/corners.md`.

## What it does

A β-multiplier current reference: 1 µA per unit device, for every analog block. `nbias` biases nfet
sinks, and `pbias` biases pfet_lvt sources. It has a startup circuit (MS1–MS3) and power-down (`pd` = 1).

## Outline and pins

Outline **22 × 26 µm** (tile x = 8 … 30, y = 188 … 214). The bandgap is below, `ptat_out` is to the right,
and the VDPWR/VGND met4 stripes are at x = 1–3 / 4–6 to the left.

| Pin | Edge | Layer | Goes to |
|---|---|---|---|
| VDPWR | left | met1 rail (top of the cell, over the n-well) | via stack to the met4 stripe at x = 1–3 |
| VGND | left | met1 rail (bottom of the cell) | via stack to the met4 stripe at x = 4–6 |
| pd | top | met2 | BG_PD: `ui_in[3]` in M1, the digital block in M2 (met3 route along the top) |
| pbias | bottom, about x = +8 µm | met2 | bandgap OTA + current sources below; met3 trunk to the right column |
| nbias | bottom, about x = +14 µm | met2 | same |

Pin x positions are suggestions; tell me where you put them and I'll route to them. Label the pins with
exactly these names (text on the metal), because the extraction reads the labels.

## Devices (20 transistors incl. 4 dummies, + 1 resistor)

| Name | Device | W / L (µm) | Count | Nets D / G / S / B | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MP1 | pfet_01v8_lvt | 2 / 2 | 1 | nbias / pbias / VDPWR / VDPWR | **matched pair** with MP2 |
| MP2 | pfet_01v8_lvt | 2 / 2 | 1 | pbias / pbias / VDPWR / VDPWR | diode |
| MN1 | nfet_01v8 | 2 / 2 | 1 | nbias / nbias / VGND / VGND | **matched 1 : 4** with MN2 |
| MN2 | nfet_01v8 | 2 / 2 | 4 (mult = 4) | pbias / nbias / nr / VGND | four separate unit devices |
| R1 | res_xhigh_po_0p35 | 0.35 / 11 | 1 | nr – VGND | ≈ 63 kΩ; sets the current |
| MS2A–E | pfet_01v8 | 0.42 / 10 | 5 in series | sup → ms2_1 → … → ms2_4 → su, G = VGND, B = VDPWR | weak pull-up; a series chain |
| MS3 | nfet_01v8 | 2 / 2 | 1 | su / nbias / VGND / VGND | |
| MS1 | nfet_01v8 | 0.42 / 1 | 1 | pbias / su / VGND / VGND | |
| MPD1 | pfet_01v8 | 0.42 / 0.5 | 1 | pbias / pdb / VDPWR / VDPWR | power-down |
| MPD2 | pfet_01v8 | 0.42 / 0.5 | 1 | sup / pd / VDPWR / VDPWR | power-down |
| MND1 | nfet_01v8 | 0.42 / 0.5 | 1 | nbias / pd / VGND / VGND | power-down |
| MND2 | nfet_01v8 | 0.42 / 0.5 | 1 | su / pd / VGND / VGND | power-down |
| MIP | pfet_01v8 | 0.84 / 1 | 1 | pdb / pd / VDPWR / VDPWR | pd inverter |
| MIN | nfet_01v8 | 0.42 / 1 | 1 | pdb / pd / VGND / VGND | pd inverter |
| MDN1, MDN2 | nfet_01v8 | 2 / 2 | 2 | all VGND | dummies at the ends of the MN row |
| MDP1, MDP2 | pfet_01v8_lvt | 2 / 2 | 2 | all VDPWR | dummies at the ends of the MP row |

Use `nf = 1` everywhere. MN2 is four separate unit devices (LVS merges parallel devices).
MS2A–E must be five devices **in series**: don't merge them into one long gate.

## Matching (CLAUDE.md rule 6)

1. **MN1 : MN2 = 1 : 4** sets the current (I ∝ ln 4 / R1). Put them in one row, same orientation, gates in
   parallel, with dummies at both ends: **`D  B B A B B  D`** (A = MN1, B = MN2). Dummies are nfet 2/2 with
   gate, drain and source tied to VGND. The B devices share source diffusion (`nr`) in pairs.
2. **MP1 / MP2** mirror: one row, **`D  A B  D`**, sharing the VDPWR source between them. Dummies are pfet_lvt 2/2
   tied to VDPWR.
3. Keep R1 next to MN2's source, with a short `nr` net. One straight resistor is fine. If you bend or split it,
   tell me, so LVS and the expected value stay the same.
4. The dummies are in the schematic (netgen does not drop shorted devices): **MDN1, MDN2** = nfet_01v8 2/2
   with D/G/S/B on VGND, and **MDP1, MDP2** = pfet_01v8_lvt 2/2 with D/G/S/B on VDPWR. If you want more
   dummies (e.g. around MS3), tell me and I'll add them to the schematic.

## Suggested placement

```
 y=26 ┌──────────────────── VDPWR rail (met1) ─────────────────────┐
      │ n-well: [D MP1 MP2 D]  [MS2A…E chain, 5 × 10 µm gates side by side] │
      │         [MPD1 MPD2 MIP]                                     │
      │ ── n-tap guard ring around the whole n-well ──              │
      │ p-tap guard ring:                                            │
      │   [D MN2 MN2 MN1 MN2 MN2 D]   [MS3] [MS1] [MND1 MND2 MIN]     │
      │   [R1 ≈ 11 µm, horizontal, under the NMOS row]               │
 y=0  └──────────────────── VGND rail (met1) ── pbias ── nbias (met2, bottom) ┘
```

- The MS2 chain is the long part: five 10 µm gates (0.42 µm wide), placed side by side as vertical strips and
  joined in a zigzag on li1/met1. That's about 8 × 11 µm.
- Guard rings: an n-tap ring (VDPWR) around the n-well, and a p-tap ring (VGND) around the NMOS + resistor area.
- Routing inside the cell: li1/met1/met2 only. Leave met3 and met4 free, because the top-level routes pass over it.

## Checks before handing it over

```bash
python3 layout/check_cell.py bias_gen --gds <your file>.gds
```

This runs Magic DRC, Magic extraction from your GDS, and netgen LVS against the schematic (property errors,
i.e. wrong W/L, count as a fail). It must say `Magic DRC: 0 errors` and `LVS: match`. Then save the GDS as
`layout/cells/bias_gen.gds`. I'll add the KLayout DRC deck run and the post-layout simulation (`--pex`
netlist into `sim/bias/tb_bias.spice`).

## Phase 2 result (sizes above are final for layout)

From `sim/bias/corners.md`: 45 runs (5 corners × −40/27/125 °C × 1.62/1.80/1.98 V). All pass.
- Unit sink is **0.68 … 1.64 µA** and unit source is 0.64 … 1.61 µA. The spread is mostly temperature
  (tt: 0.73 µA at −40 °C, 1.51 µA at 125 °C), because I ∝ VT / R1. Process moves it only ±3 %.
  Every consumer's own Phase 2 sweep must use this range.
- Line regulation is ≤ 8.9 % (target < 10 %). Startup works on both ramps in 45/45 runs, and is
  running by VDPWR ≤ 0.98 V. Power-down current is ≤ 43 nA (125 °C).
